1.explanation:
• src/table/base/sort.jsx: This component renders the sort icons (asc/desc) and handles click events. We need to ensure its container or icon elements carry a `cursor: pointer` style.
• src/table/base/header.jsx: This file wraps column headers, including the clickable area for sorting. Any onClick wrapper here should also show a pointer cursor when sorting is enabled.
• src/table/main.scss: The global SCSS for table defines styles for header cells and sort icons. We must add a rule like `.${prefix}-table-header-cell-sortable { cursor: pointer; }` or target the sort icon itself.
• src/table/rtl.scss: The right-to-left stylesheet overrides table styles for RTL layouts; it also needs the same `cursor: pointer` rule so the fix applies in RTL mode.
1.bug_scenario: In the Table component’s header cells that have sorting enabled (via the `sortable` prop), the up/down sort icons are clickable but do not show a pointer cursor on hover. When you hover over the sort icons in the official examples, the cursor stays as the default arrow instead of switching to a pointer, which is a poor affordance for clickable controls.

2.explanation: The header.jsx file is responsible for rendering each `<th>` in the table and applies the `sortable` flag on header columns. It wraps the sort icons (the clickable area) with a Sort component. The sort.jsx file actually renders the sort icon elements and handles the click event for sorting. Neither component currently adds a CSS cursor style to indicate clickability. The main.scss file contains all of the Table component’s styling (including header and icon styles), so it is the place to add or adjust the `cursor: pointer` rule. By updating these three files, we ensure the sort icons and their container render with a pointer cursor when hovered, clearly signaling to users that the header is interactive.
2.bug_scenario: On the Table component’s example (e.g. the Sorting & Filtering demo), when a column is marked `sortable` the sort icons appear, but hovering over the icon or header does not change the cursor to a pointer. This makes it unclear to users that the icon is clickable to sort the column.
